scenario: AITA for telling my GF [24F] that I want to be one of my cousin's fiance's groomsman? | I \[25 M\] got asked to be a groomsman for a wedding later on in the year, told my GF about it and she gave me an ultimatum of either being with HER or being a GROOMSMAN. Also, I will be walking with one of my female cousins during the wedding, I see this as no big deal. ​ Background: Been with this girl for about 3 months now and I told her about this today and she threw a fit about it and made me choose a decision. Does this girl fit the description of someone controlling or crazy? ​ ​
